## Goal

Turn MADC-format targeted genotyping data into a clean representation suitable for downstream genomic analysis.

## Why this belongs in the portal

This is a durable **workflow** rather than merely a function reference. Users need to understand quality filtering, dosage conventions, coordinate validity, sorting, and VCF expectations as a connected process.

[Open the current BIGr tutorial](https://breeding-insight.github.io/BIGr_documentation/){.btn-bi-primary}
[Explore BIGr](../software/bigr.qmd){.btn-bi-secondary}

## Proposed migrated outline

1. Inspect the MADC file and identify required metadata.
2. Filter low-quality loci and samples.
3. Standardize genotype/dosage conventions.
4. Validate chromosome and position fields.
5. Write, sort, compress, and index the VCF.
6. Run checkpoints before downstream analysis.
7. Continue to PCA, GWAS, genomic prediction, or other analyses.
